name: Oosuzuki Kurara
source:
Zodiac Sign: Libra
Likes: World Domination
Dislikes: Peonies, Roses, Camellias
Specialist Skill: Special Crafting

"Oho... You're wondering why I'd hide my noble visage beneath this mask, aren't you? Know your place, scum! Don't insult your betters by trying to understand their decisions!"

The scion of one of the most wealthy families humanity has ever known. She's proud, overbearing, and acts like she's better than anyone else. She always wears a strange tomato mask, never showing her true face.
